name: WebAppRater

sources.title: Homepage — active WordPress review blog (posts through Sep 2026); 'Submit App' nav link
Submit your app for review — Featured Review and Network Review options; submission is a Wufoo form

requirements: Accepts web apps and mobile apps; also explicitly interested in pre-release and beta versions

Two offerings: 'Featured Review' (guaranteed review, posted forever, sticky on homepage for at least 30 days) and 'Network Review' (unique reviews published across partner sites AppsTimes.in, AppsMirror.com, AppsListo.com, AppsThunder.com)
Actual intake is a Wufoo form embedded on the submit page
preparation: Short product description and screenshots for the reviewer
Contact email — the form likely leads to a pricing quote since no price is published
Decide whether you want a single review or the multi-site Network Review package
workflow: Fill out the embedded Wufoo form (amp2.wufoo.com/forms/m155yblq03stsxk)
Expect a follow-up email with review pricing — 'guaranteed review' language indicates this is a paid-review service
After acceptance, the review publishes as a post under category/reviews and may be stickied on the homepage for 30 days
watchFor: No pricing published on the page — treat as a paid review service and expect a sales follow-up
The 'guaranteed review' framing means this is pay-for-coverage, not editorial listing; don't report it as earned coverage
Site footer says 'Promoted by AppMarketingPlus' — the submit page is a lead-gen funnel for an app-marketing agency
Homepage mixes app reviews with off-topic sponsored articles (peptides, clenbuterol, teeth whitening, MLM software) — low editorial signal
countsAsLive: A review post about the product is published on webapprater.com (visible under /category/reviews or the homepage sticky area)
unknowns: Exact pricing for Featured and Network reviews
Whether any free submission path exists — none is offered on the page
Turnaround time from form submission to published review
